newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Moody's reviews Swiss Re rating.
newsitem.headline: Moody's reviews Swiss Re rating.

text.p: Moody's Investors Service said it was reviewing the Aaa insurance financial strength rating of Swiss Reinsurance Co. for a possible downgrade.
Moody's said in statement from its London office received in Zurich that around $650 million of long-term securities were affected.

The review, which was prompted by Swiss Re's 1.7 billion sterling acquisition of Mercantile and General Re from Prudential Corp Plc, affects Swiss Re, SwissRe America and the European Reinsurance Co. of Zurich.
It has also placed under review for possible downgrade its Aaa ratings on the senior unsecured debt of SwissRe Finance (Bermuda) Ltd. and SwissRe Finance (US) Inc.

The review will focus on the effects the acquisition will have on the capitalisation, profitability and business profile of Swiss Re and management's business strategy, including the role of further acquisitions, Moody's said.
